display_long_description:
VICE MIAMI: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE

The city is open, it’s free to play, and now you can explore it with friends. Vice Miami is an open-world VR sandbox where you make the rules.

MULTIPLAYER IS HERE
Team up with friends and take over the city. Cruise the strip, hit the Night Club as a crew, or settle things with your fists. Live now!

BE WHO YOU WANT TO BE
Create a male or female character and customize every detail: eye color, lip color, height, body type, outfits and more.

REAL PHYSICS, REAL CHAOS
Grab any character with full physics. Drag them, throw them, or fight it out. Every hit and fall reacts to your movement.

GUNS AND PREMIUM CARS
Gear up with weapons and drive premium cars. Cruise at sunset or tear through the streets at night.

NEW IN THIS UPDATE

Multiplayer: explore and cause chaos with friends
Night Club: hit the dance floor
Garage: store and show off your rides
Gun Store: pick up new weapons

COMING SOON

Gas Station and Mart: work as an employee
New places and features over time

Built with our players. Tell us what you want next in the reviews. Planned features may change before release.

Download free, bring your friends, and own the night.
